Events in the year 2026 in Benin.
== Events ==
=== January ===
11 January – 2026 Beninese parliamentary election: The pro-Talon Progressive Union Renewal and Republican Bloc parties win all 109 seats in the National Assembly.
1 January – New Year's Day
10 January – Vaudoun Day

On January 11, 2026, the Beninese parliamentary election will take place, where the pro-Talon Progressive Union Renewal and Republican Bloc parties are expected to win all 109 seats in the National Assembly. 

FINAL: Beninese parliamentary election.
